component.name: core.openwop.workflows.content
component.description: Real-work workflow pack (RFC 0013, ADR 0190 Phase 3) — the Content & Monitoring cluster: watch an RSS/Atom feed for new items and watch any web page for changes, each pairing a schedule trigger with durable seen-state in host KV storage (deterministic per-source key; the first run treats everything as new and seeds the state). NO host RSS poller exists — adding an 'rss' ingestion source to /v1/trigger-subscriptions is RFC 0099 wire territory (see ADR 0190) — so these chains ARE the poller: pair each with a Schedule and the scheduler does the polling. Authored over shipped node typeIds (core.trigger.schedule + core.openwop.http.fetch + core.storage.kv-get/kv-set + core.ai.chatCompletion + core.openwop.integration.notification-push). No external sends — digests are in-app notifications, so no approval gate is needed. All tenant values are run parameters (replay-deterministic).
